title: Launch placement, model pairs and quota
summary: An item launch routes by the item's effective workflow stage level, then surface, model, effort and machine; launch preview --item previews that same route. Level and placement flags are overrides. Machine lane capacity counts registered workers whose native process is alive plus unregistered in-flight worker launches. Process-gone parked workers retain claims without using a lane; resumed workers count again. A usage reading never refuses a launch; a launch whose CLI never registers records that harness's login command as sign_in_recovery, since the CLI may be signed out.
